title: ophrys umbilicata subsp. flavomarginata
intro:
Ophrys umbilicata subsp. flavomarginata, commonly known as the yellow-fringed orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family, characterized by its distinctive yellow-striped leaves and yellowish-green flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, Ophrys umbilicata subsp. flavomarginata is believed to have sedative and antispasmodic actions, which may help in relieving muscle cramps and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
